description: Scripted-fault fixture (§ Deliverable 3) for the page-crash reopen path (§3.6). The form→results click crashes the page on its first trigger, then succeeds. A payload with retry.onPageCrashed:"reopenPage" closes the crashed page, opens a fresh one on the SAME session, rebinds it, and re-runs from the top — the goto re-navigates the new page to the form, and the second trigger succeeds. The per-transition attempt count lives on the session so it survives the reopen.
